# Magical Aura Pro Painters Ltd

> Surrey and Lower Mainland painting company. Interior and exterior residential and commercial painting. Clean prep, no mess left behind. Phone number coming soon — use the contact form. Based in Surrey, BC.

Magical Aura Pro Painters Ltd paints homes and businesses across Surrey and the Lower Mainland. Every job is quoted in writing. Floors, furniture and fixtures are protected, and we leave the space tidy.

## Services
- [Trim & Doors](https://magicalaurapainting.ca/services/trim-and-doors.html): Trim, doors and interior woodwork painted cleanly, with floors and hardware protected.
- [Interior Painting](https://magicalaurapainting.ca/services/interior-painting.html): Walls, ceilings and rooms painted with careful prep, even coats and a tidy finish.
- [Exterior Painting](https://magicalaurapainting.ca/services/exterior-painting.html): Siding, fascia, soffits and exterior trim painted to stand up to Lower Mainland weather.
- [Cabinet Painting](https://magicalaurapainting.ca/services/cabinet-painting.html): Kitchen and bathroom cabinets painted for a fresh finish without a full replacement.
- [Drywall Repair & Paint Prep](https://magicalaurapainting.ca/services/drywall-repair.html): Holes, cracks and texture mismatches patched, sanded and primed so the paint looks even.
- [Ceiling & Popcorn Removal](https://magicalaurapainting.ca/services/ceiling-painting.html): Ceilings painted evenly — including popcorn and other textures you want to keep, skim, or coat.
- [Colour Consult](https://magicalaurapainting.ca/services/colour-consult.html): Help choosing colours and sheens that work with your light, floors and trim — then we paint them.
- [Deck & Fence Staining](https://magicalaurapainting.ca/services/deck-fence-staining.html): Decks and fences stained to handle Lower Mainland weather.
- [Wood Staining](https://magicalaurapainting.ca/services/wood-staining.html): Accent walls, millwork and outdoor wood stained evenly, with nearby surfaces protected.
- [Commercial Painting](https://magicalaurapainting.ca/services/commercial-painting.html): Retail, office, warehouse and light industrial — painted around your hours, with clean prep and a tidy finish.
- [Commercial Unit Painting](https://magicalaurapainting.ca/services/tenant-improvements.html): Opening or renovating a commercial space? We deliver the painting scope on time — walls, ceilings, millwork — coordinated with every other trade.
- [Strata Painting](https://magicalaurapainting.ca/services/strata-painting.html): Property managers and strata councils trust Magical Aura for common-area, suite and building painting across the Lower Mainland.
- [Paint Prep](https://magicalaurapainting.ca/services/paint-prep.html): Masking, sanding, priming and protection so the finish coat looks even — and the mess stays off your floors.
- [New-Home Painting](https://magicalaurapainting.ca/services/new-home-painting.html): New construction finishing, builder touch-ups and first coats so a new home looks complete.
